[P2] Justify the untested outside-literal rejection branch

This violates Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” The added backslash rejection cases encounter the character inside quotes and are handled by the earlier branch; none depends on this outside-literal check. Existing structured-tool backslash tests reject their inputs before reaching the validator. Return to the design phase under Rule 8 to establish whether this additional restriction is necessary and what observable behavior requires it.
